title: How Context Windows Work
excerpt: Tokens in, tokens out: what a context window really costs.

content.p: Picking a model is about trade-offs: speed, quality and price. We break down the dimensions that matter for context windows.
Before you choose, define what good looks like for your task. Then compare candidates against that bar instead of guessing.
Here are the questions people ask most often about this topic.

faq.q: How long does context windows take?
faq.a: It depends on your setup, but most people finish in well under ten minutes with the steps above.

faq.q: Do I need any special tools?
faq.a: No. Anything that can make an HTTPS call works: curl, Python, Node.js or your favorite HTTP client.
No more than a normal request. The techniques here are designed to keep your spend predictable.

faq.q: Where can I get more help?
faq.a: Check the forum or email support and we will point you in the right direction.
